edition.title: Radak on the Torah, in Eliyahu Munk, HaChut Hameshulash

work.author: David Kimhi (Radak)
work.description: Radak's commentary on the Torah, written in Provence around the turn of the thirteenth century. Radak works from grammar and plain sense, reports midrash as midrash, and is unusually willing to say that a scriptural comparison is hyperbole. A locus is BookToken.chapter.verse.
work.title: Perush al ha-Torah
